run_grpo_training_catch: run GRPO training with OpenSpiel Catch environment and vLLM for an AI agent that catches falling balls
start_env_server: start a FastAPI server for the OpenSpiel Catch environment on a specified host and port
parse_args: parse command-line arguments for GRPO training including env mode, model, dataset size, and vLLM settings
reward_from_env: compute rewards for GRPO training by returning max(env.reward, 0.0) when episodes are done
build_catchenv_class: build a CatchEnv class that wraps the OpenSpiel environment with reset, move, and stay methods for GRPO training
